title: Yard Rules for RV & Boat Storage Space Transfers, Autopay and Electric Hookup
content:
Space transfers and option changes on an RV & Boat Storage rental are made only while the rental is active.

**Transfers.** A renter may move to another vacant space whose class entry gate the unit meets; the transfer is charged the space transfer fee and the new space's rent applies from the next month. A transfer records the new space number, the class of the new space and its monthly rent.

**Options.** The options are autopay and the electric hookup. The electric hookup may be enrolled only on a space class where the electric hookup is available; autopay may be enrolled or cancelled at any time while active, effective from the next month's rent.

**Use of the space.** A space may never be sublet or used for a unit that does not belong to the household.

The rental's status is read from the company's record of that storage rental, and the transfer or option change is made on that same rental.

### Status table

| Status of the rental | Space transfer | Option change (autopay or electric hookup) |
|---|---|---|
| active | may be made | may be made |
| reserved | not made | not made |
| past-due lockout | not made | not made |
| under notice to vacate | not made | not made |
| closed | not made | not made |

### Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

- An active renter asks to enroll in the electric hookup on a space class where the electric hookup is not available. The rental is active, but the class has no hookup, so it is not enrolled.
- An active renter enrolls in autopay partway through a month. Autopay takes effect from the next month's rent.
- An active renter moves to a vacant space of another class whose entry gate the unit meets. The transfer fee is charged, and the new space's rent applies from the next month; the current month stays at the rent of the space being left.
- A renter whose gate access is suspended for unpaid rent asks to cancel autopay. The rental is in past-due lockout, not active, so the change is not made while it is in that status.
